scope: synthetic scenario and chronological retrospective holdouts
overall_score_method: Equal-weighted mean of portfolio section scores.

sections.evidence: 30-day rolling-origin backtest: published moving_average_28 MAE 2.95 admissions/day; xgboost_recursive MAE 3.10; the learned model does not beat the best naive baseline, so the baseline is published. One-step XGBoost holdout: 89% of departments beat the same-weekday baseline (mean MAE change 13.8%).
sections.limitation: Daily admissions are close to Poisson noise around a stable level; a learned model adds little over a moving average in this synthetic scenario.

sections.evidence: 30-day rolling-origin backtest: published ridge_recursive MAE 8.56 beds; ridge_blend MAE 11.64; best naive (moving_average_28) MAE 11.89; the learned model beats every naive baseline. One-step holdout beats the same-weekday baseline with WAPE 2.8%.
sections.limitation: Forecast is synthetic and does not establish live capacity accuracy.

sections.evidence: Holdout MAE 0.74 admissions/day beats the baseline.
sections.limitation: This forecasts admissions flow, not occupied ICU census; low-count R² can remain unstable.
Individual stays can still deviate by several days; use intervals for capacity planning.

sections.evidence: Brier score 0.113 vs prevalence baseline 0.128; ROC-AUC 0.741; meets the reliability threshold.
sections.limitation: Use only for outreach prioritization; never use it as a patient or access decision.

sections.evidence: Input audit passed and the optimized scenario has zero modeled bed overflow.
sections.limitation: Zero overflow depends on scenario-only surge beds and is not current hospital capacity.

sections.evidence: All modeled shift positions are filled while hours and rest constraints are enforced.
sections.limitation: Roster and flex staff are synthetic scenario assumptions, not hiring commitments.

sections.evidence: Schedule feasibility and provider-conflict gates passed.
sections.limitation: No-show scores are not used to move appointments; clinical priority remains human-controlled.

sections.evidence: Shared ICU/emergency capacity gates passed with no modeled overflow.
sections.limitation: Scenario-only surge capacity and synthetic staffing make this a stress-test, not a live guarantee.

sections.evidence: Cross-file identifiers, dates, grains, forecast horizons, and feasibility gates were checked.
sections.limitation: Synthetic provenance means structural validity is not external clinical validity.
